issues.detail: The instructions lack coverage of error handling and edge cases.

scenarios.name: setup-social-app-navigation
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers the required file structure, Tabs component with Ionicons, root Stack with modal, dynamic post route using useLocalSearchParams, and is close to the rubric, missing only the deep link note; Response B uses a different navigation library and omits the specified file names and dynamic route.

scenarios.name: configure-deep-linking
scenarios.rationale: Response A is more comprehensive, covering Android Asset Links, detailed link handling code, and a full checklist, while Response B omits the Android assetlinks.json and is slightly less detailed.
